text:
You need an aesthetically pleasing, efficient website for your Afro hair braiding program that clearly presents the mission, includes video integration, and organizes key pages like registration, contact, partnerships, team, and program information.

Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’d love to help bring this website to life. With 7 years of experience building modern web experiences, I can create a clean, welcoming, and easy-to-navigate site that supports your goal of teaching and empowering inner city youth. I work with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, so I can handle both the visual design and the technical build with a full-stack approach.

For a project like this, I’d focus on making the site feel professional, warm, and easy for visitors to engage with. I can design the homepage to clearly introduce the program, integrate video in a way that feels natural and compelling, and build dedicated tabs for Registration, Contact Us, Partnership Info, Our Team, and Program Info. I’d also make sure the layout is responsive and works well across desktop and mobile devices, so people can access the information easily from anywhere.

Since you’ll be providing feedback on what you’re looking for, I can work collaboratively while still taking ownership of the creative direction. I’m comfortable translating general ideas into a polished design and making thoughtful choices around spacing, typography, color, and page structure to match the purpose of the program. The result should feel trustworthy, engaging, and clear for parents, students, and potential partners alike.

If needed, I can also help ensure the site structure is set up to support future growth, so it can expand as the program evolves.

What specific video format or placement would you like for the website’s homepage or program section?
